C. 7.073e-27

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path":"q.phr","new_content":"SOLUTION 1
    temp 25
    pH 7.5
    units mg/L
    Ca 100
    Alkalinity 250 as CaCO3

SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -reset false
    -high_precision true
    -activity true

USER_PUNCH
    -headings a_H2
10 PUNCH ACT("H2")
"}
